purpose: preregistered finite held-out evaluation; not a training or accuracy promise
question: How do base, prompt-only, updated visual RAG, adapted released MEND and 15-step last-layer FT compare on generated-answer accuracy, generalization, locality, routing and latency for 20 source-entity-separated edit lineages?
estimate_limitations: One fixed TRAIN episode only; sequence lengths and hardware load vary. Roughly 15.5 minutes extrapolated worker time, not a promise or confidence interval. Integrity verification/sealing adds several minutes outside worker time.

measured_resources.limits: RSS sampling can miss short spikes; CUDA allocator figures do not include every driver allocation. These are diagnostic-run resources, not a serving latency benchmark.

inputs: Exact pinned VLKEB upstream and base/model/editor assets
Deterministically selected 20 source-entity-separated edit lineages and verified images
Frozen MiniLM assets and train-row2..9 validation-selected RAG threshold
Fixed five-method/five-case protocol, whole-answer scorer, seed42, greedy24token budget
expected_artifacts: PNG/PDF graphs with CSV/JSON source data
finite_stopping_condition: 20 edit lineages x5 query cases x5 methods =500query instances, at most20MENDupdates and300FToptimizer steps per uninterrupted complete attempt; stop early on exact-restoration failure or timeout
resume: Completed rollback-checked rows are immutable. Same sealed code/configuration only. An incomplete interrupted lineage reruns from a fresh base and is disclosed in attempt receipts. No model meta-training is performed.
configuration_freeze: Publish selection/calibration/profile receipts and source before --seal; do not alter the scientific configuration after test outputs are viewed.
commands: python -m ke_repro.evaluate --run --resume (only for interruption, same unchanged seal)
review_policy: Automated structural label audit only, explicitly authorized; no independent human label review claim
result_claims: All20lineages retained in denominators, errors and abstentions count as primary failures; published metrics remain separately attributed.
